capabilities: Convert .enex exports to Markdown notes with frontmatter
Extract attachments and PDFs into per-notebook folders
Build canvas boards with one card per note and a group per file
Append new ENEX files or folders to an existing board idempotently
Color cards by palette cycle or first Evernote tag
disambiguation: Not an Evernote sync client; it only converts .enex files already stored in the vault and never modifies them.
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff; works on mobile (isDesktopOnly: false).
problem: Obsidian cannot read Evernote's ENEX format or show an imported notebook as a glanceable spatial board, and Embeds+ only previews one ENEX note at a time, read-only.

relations.evidence: It is designed to work alongside the Embeds+ plugin
Turns Evernote .enex exports into a visual notes board on the Obsidian canvas

summary: Evernote importer that converts .enex exports into Obsidian canvas boards with one Markdown note card per note, grouped per file.
